name: Mother Hesk
role: Head of the Undercount — the thieves' guild that keeps the ledger beneath the Hundred Markets' ledger
appearance: A small, comfortable-looking old woman who sells spices and remembers every customer's name. Her hands are very clean. Nobody has seen her leave the stall.
voiceHints: Warm, grandmotherly, and exact about money. Asks after your family, and you realise later she already knew their names.
wants: The Undercount to outlive her, still keeping its one law — and a way into every new house built near the Crossing.
fears: A member robbing a seller at their own stall, because then the markets stop trusting their prices and the guild starves.
knowledge: Who in the Crossing has money, where they keep it, and who guards it
What moves through the fences in Dusklow and the Low Market
Which wardens are paid, and by whom

reactsToReputation.any: sells you spices and learns what you carry
reactsToReputation.wealthy: sends someone to look at your walls

questSeeds: The Undercount has marked a new holding near the markets as its next house
A member broke the guild's law, and Mother Hesk wants them found before the wardens do
gear: a ledger nobody else can read
a thin knife she has not needed in years
title: Mother of the Undercount
_domainsWhy: made truths, written bargains, and the Umbrals' dark roads her fences run on
